name: review-after-commit
description: Deliver a read-only exact-range review request after configured commit events.

interface.shortDescription: Review exact commit events without changing the repository.
interface.longDescription: Adds lifecycle hooks that deliver host-neutral read-only review requests at the configured cadence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Work normally. When the enabled hook supplies a ReviewRequest, perform the requested read-only advisory review in the conversation.
